description: This file defines a public interface function 'subtitle_alignment' for aligning and correcting subtitles based on a transcript. It serves as a wrapper around an internal 'correct_subtitles' function imported from the same package, with added type checks and documentation.

methods.name: subtitle_alignment(transcript, subtitles)
methods.description: Aligns and corrects subtitles based on the provided transcript, delegating to 'correct_subtitles'.
